mapper.insert: INSERT INTO FOLLOW (FOLLOW_NO, FOLLOWER_NO, FOLLOWING_NO) VALUES (SEQ_FOLLOW_NO.NEXTVAL, #{followerNo}, #{followingNo})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWING_NO = #{memberNo}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWER_NO = #{memberNo}

SELECT F.FOLLOW_NO, F.FOLLOWER_NO, F.FOLLOWING_NO, M.MEMBER_NICKNAME AS MEMBER_NICKNAME, M.PROFILE_IMG AS PROFILE_IMG FROM FOLLOW F JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = F.FOLLOWER_NO WHERE F.FOLLOWING_NO = #{memberNo} ORDER BY F.FOLLOW_NO DESC
